properties.description:
Built 2026-10-12 on branch docs/the-site-says-what-reflow2-is-and-is-not (chg:the-site-says-what-reflow2-is-and-is-not-in-plain-words-2026-10-12). It stays in_progress until Anthony has read the pages, because whether a non-technical reader understands them is his call. Three pages:
- **The home page (site/index.html), rewritten.** It covers the is / is-not of the partnership: the person decides, the AI drafts, asks and checks, the graph remembers. It covers the five decision steps in everyday words, and one design first, with the hub offered as the next step. It also says that reflow2 runs no AI, what it is not needed for, and which part carries over to a project that is not software.
- **A new page, the walkthrough.** A made-up example design is followed from its first requirement into the code and back (drift caught, a change's reach seen before the edit, results fed back). Each step is labelled with the person, the AI or the graph.
- **A new page, the why.** Each weakness of an AI (memory, confidence, agreeing) and of a person (confirmation bias, anchoring, slow drift) sits beside the check that answers it, drawn from docs/partnership.md. Fast and slow thinking is told as a likeness, and nothing claims reflow2 removes bias.

site/hub.html stays the guide to several designs, and "project brain" names only one of the two. Each page joins the per-release content check (req:every-release-brings-reflow2s-site-up-to-date-with-what-it-ships). Pages are hand-written with made-up examples (dec:the-sites-setup-pages-are-hand-written-and-its-design-pages-stay-generated).

2026-10-12, after #734 merged (8eccc72e4): the pages are live. Anthony said "merge 734 when green" but has not yet said the pages read right for a non-technical reader, so this stays in_progress. He will ask his brother for input. His brother uses reflow2 for a non-software project, and Anthony has shared a hub with him on flo2.io. The next session should look in that hub for the input before calling these pages done. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: The site explains reflow2 in three pages, plain first: what it is and is not along the five decision steps, one design followed into the code and back, and a deeper page on why
